ModMetaData.name: The Moat
ModMetaData.author: Keldarton
ModMetaData.description:
A mod for players who want to build a subterranean colony, heavily relying on the supreme defensive capabilities of living under a mountain.
Have you ever wanted to carve your entire civilization into living rock, safe from aerial drop pods, while funneling every hostile raid into a single, fortified chokepoint? The Moat is built for players who love the atmosphere of being besieged inside a cozy, impenetrable mountain fortress while facing the untamed wild outside.
KEY DEFENSIVE HIGHLIGHTS: - Single Choke Point: Channel every enemy raid, manhunter pack, and mechanoid threat into a single grand entrance or killbox. - No Aerial Drop Pod Raids: The entire mountain half is sheltered under thick overhead mountain (RoofRockThick) — no drop pods crashing through your bedrooms, hospital, or rec room! - Concentrated Defenses: Forget 360-degree perimeter paranoia. Focus your turrets, bunkers, and traps where it matters. - A Cozy Mountain to Defend: Survive in comfort under stone while chaos reigns in the wilderness.
MAP GENERATION: - Left Half (West): Solid, impassable mountain rock with overhead mountain roof. Zero caves, zero hollow pockets, zero surprise backdoors. Ore veins spawn throughout the mountain by default so your miners have resources to unearth. - Right Half (East): Flat open land free of obstructive mountains, hills, or lakes. All vanilla surface features generate freely: trees, fertile soil, ancient dangers, steam geysers, ruins, roads, and the Anomaly Void Monolith. - Starting Colony Only: Affects only your initial colony map. All future quest maps, satellite settlements, and encounter sites generate standard vanilla terrain.
CUSTOMIZABLE SETTINGS: - Mountain width slider (30% to 70%, default 50%). - Toggle mineable ore veins in the mountain (default: ON). - Toggle removal of lakes on plains (default: ON). - Toggle flattening of hills on plains (default: ON).
GITHUB REPOSITORY: https://github.com/federicogiorgi/TheMoat Issues, discussions, and contributions are welcome!
Requires Harmony. Compatible with RimWorld 1.5 and 1.6.
